## Case
City of Milwaukee Tax Incremental District No. 121 (Bronzeville Arts & Tech Hub), NW corner of W. North Ave and N. 6th St. The 2024 Project Plan (Common Council file 240382) sets the City's TID capital contribution and the housing/commercial program. Later public records revise the contribution (Amendment No. 1, file 260433) and report status (2024 Annual TID Report, file 250623). The 2025 Annual TID Report is expected but not yet published.

## Decision Delta (REVISED)
The 2024 Project Plan set TID Capital Project Costs at an up-to amount of $700,000 (plan p.5). Amendment No. 1 (2026) sets TID Capital Project Costs at $2,345,000, adding an up-to $1,645,000 grant to the Developer/Commercial Owner (amendment p.3). The later document revises the City's stated contribution; the record supplied does not state why.

### What the record establishes
- 2024 Project Plan, Table A: TOTAL Capital Project Costs $700,000, up-to amount (plan p.5).
- Amendment No. 1: the City shall fund an estimated $2,345,000 in TID Capital Project Costs (amendment p.3).
- Amendment No. 1, Table A: adds Grant to Project (Monetary Obligation to Developer/Commercial Owner) $1,645,000, up-to amount (amendment p.3).

### What the record does not establish
- Why the amendment was needed; the supplied record does not state a reason.
- Whether any of the 60 housing units are built or occupied; no supplied record addresses construction or occupancy.
- Whether any grant funds have been disbursed after 12/31/2024; the latest supplied status report is the 2024 Annual TID Report.

### Limitations
- Both figures are up-to ceilings, not amounts spent.
- This is a comparison of two public documents, not a finding about performance or conduct.

## Proposed next question (SOURCE_QUESTION)

**Why this scope.** The staged delta compares the 2024 Project Plan Capital Project Costs of $700,000 (plan p.5) with Amendment No. 1's $2,345,000 (amendment p.3). The latest supplied status record is the 2024 Annual TID Report; the 2025 report is the next expected public record that could show whether any grant funds were disbursed after 12/31/2024.
